subject: No support for 'subdir' where using GitHub

messages.author: 2e1695c2061d5312
messages.subject: No support for 'subdir' where using GitHub
parts:
Hi there,

I have been trying to deploy our app to ShinyApps.io using a custom package which I have put as a private repo on Github.com._ My previous question at https://groups.google.com/forum/#!topic/shinyapps-users/JRfN4UBcVQs explains the setup and a problem I had with the repository permissioning which has now been fixed.

It now seems that I can't use the 'subdir' argument to install_github and have SA.io correctly install my package. The package directory was originally in a subdirectory of the repo root.

> install_github("mycompany/mypackage", subdir="packagename", auth_token="15ef...414a")
Downloading github repo prismfp/mypackage@master
Installing packagename
...

* installing *source* package 'packagename' ...
...
* DONE (packagename)
> shinyapps::deployApp('.')
Preparing to deploy application...DONE
Uploading application bundle...DONE
Deploying application: 41756...
Waiting for task: 32976894
  building: Parsing manifest
  building: Building image: 180996
  building: Fetching packages
  error: Building package: packagename
################################## Begin Log ################################## 
################################### End Log ################################### 
Error: Unhandled Exception: Child Task 32976895 failed: Error building image: Error fetching packagename (0.23.0) source. Package source does not appear to be a package

I then changed the github repository so that the files in the 'packagename' directory were moved to the root directory of the repository. I reran the above two commands, omitting the 'subdir=' from the install_github call. The app installed packages and deployed correctly.

I wanted to know - am I doing things incorrectly or is the subdir argument to install_github not currently supported? If not, is there any possibility that it could be in the future? I can live with the workaround above, but would much prefer not to have to use it.

Thanks very much,
Jack

messages.author: e84e7628b5f8a3e1
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] No support for 'subdir' where using GitHub
parts:
Jack,

The subdir parameter is supported (a change I made a few weeks back). By any chance do you have a mixed case repository?

I have seen some issues when there is case mismatch. For example:

If your repo name is 'MyPackage' running install_github('someuser/mypackage', subdir="derp") works when installing locally, but will fail to install on shinyapps. In this case you need to ensure you use the exact repository name: install_github('someuser/MyPackage', subdir="derp") 

This is only an issue when using the subdir parameter (When not using a subdir, any casing on the repo name is fine).

-Andy
